table.name: TLGNC_TRSP_ZONE_VERTEX
table.description: Defines a vertex (point) of a polygon which is associated with a Transport Zone. Vertices are put in a sequence. Google Map calculations do not distinguish clockwise/counter-clockwise definitions of polygons to decide if a point is inside/outside a line.

column.name: TRSP_ZONE_POLYGON_ID
column.description: FK trsp_trsp_zone_polygon. The polygon to which a vertex belongs.

column.name: SEQ_NO
column.description: The vertices with the same trsp_zone_polygon_id are put in a sequence, defined by this number.
